headline: No new events as lines drift
body: A quiet day with no scored events. All endings moved by less than 0.1 point as recent announcements faded; Gatekeeper slipped about 0.05 as the lift from earlier coordination news wore off. The world factors held steady, and Horizon Balance was nearly unchanged at -0.31.
movers_note: Only small drifts as earlier news faded: Protector God -0.05 and Gatekeeper -0.05.
